definitions.explanation: The number five. A central number in Japanese culture, found in many traditional concepts. Straightforward to use with most counters.

examples.english: I wake up at five o'clock.

examples.japanese: {五|ご}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{五|ご}{月|がつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{五|ご}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}らなければなりません→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I have plans with a friend, so I have to be home by five o'clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{五|ご}{日|にち}⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧で、⟦{土曜日|どようび}→土曜日：00621_doyoubi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なっています→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese companies, it's normal to work five days a week, with Saturday and Sunday off.

notes:
{五|ご} is the Sino-Japanese reading for five, used with most counters and in compounds.

READINGS:
- ご: Sino-Japanese (used with counters like ⟦{個|こ}→〜個：00645_ko⟧, ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧, ⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧)
- いつ: appears in いつつ (native counter for objects)

COMMON USES:
- {五|ご}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: 5 o'clock
- {五|ご}{月|がつ}: May
- {五|ご}{日|にち}: the 5th (of the month)
- {五|ご}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: five people
- {五|いつ}つ: five (objects)

CULTURAL:
- {五|ご}{感|かん}: the five senses
- {五|ご}{輪|りん}: the Olympic rings; also Buddhist five elements
- {五|ご}{十|じゅっ}{音|おん}: the Japanese syllabary order

NOTE:
Five is considered a balanced number in East Asian cultures, associated with the five elements.
